invite.title: Join {workspace}

roleHelp.MEMBER: Members work the leads assigned to them, check leads in the review queue and record outcomes.
roleHelp.ADMIN: Admins change settings, lead sources and routing rules, and invite people.

invite.emailHint: The invite is tied to this address.
invite.name: Full name
invite.existingNote: You already have a LeadPilot account with this email. Enter its password to join.
invite.attemptsNote: After 5 wrong passwords this invite expires and you will need a new one.
invite.accountAppeared: An account with this email now exists. Enter its password to join.
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link no longer works
invite.invalidBody: It expired, was cancelled or was already used. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.invalidTooMany: An invite also expires after 5 wrong passwords.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. It may have been removed.
errors.CONFLICT: That clashes with a recent change. Reload and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don’t match.
errors.AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED: For your security, you were signed out everywhere. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_NO_WORKSPACE: This account isn’t part of any workspace anymore. Ask an admin to invite you again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invite link no longer works. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
errors.OWNER_IMMUTABLE: The owner can’t be changed or removed.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: You can’t change your own role or remove yourself.
errors.NETWORK: Can’t reach LeadPilot. Check your connection and try again.

roleHelp.OWNER: Everything an admin can do, plus deleting the workspace. There’s one owner.
roleHelp.ADMIN: Changes settings, lead sources and routing rules, and invites and manages Members.

confirm.title: Remove {name} from {workspace}?
confirm.body: {name} won’t be able to sign in to this workspace. Their leads become unassigned until they get a new owner. Nothing is deleted, and their account stays.

empty.title: It’s just you for now
empty.body: Invite your sales reps so LeadPilot can assign leads to them. They join as Members and only see leads.
